title: models.v1
description: The model catalog. Two shapes: Catalog is what the operator declares (VEXA_MODEL_CATALOG, agent-api's environment) — the providers this deployment reaches and the models it offers on each; ModelList is what agent-api serves to the terminal and the MCP (GET /api/models) — the models one person may pick, with no endpoint, credential or request setting in it. A credential is only ever a reference (secret_ref), never a value (P14).

ModelId.description: A catalog id: what a chat, a routine and a person's default name. Stable across releases of the catalog; never the provider's own model id.

ProviderKey.description: The operator's name for one provider declaration (e.g. lab-vllm, openrouter).

Adapter.description: Which provider adapter resolves a model on this provider. openai_compatible: a self-hosted vLLM / llama.cpp / LiteLLM or any OpenAI-compatible gateway, on the openai-agent harness. openrouter: OpenRouter, on the openai-agent harness (/api/v1) or the claude-code harness (its Anthropic-compatible /api), as the provider declares. anthropic: Anthropic directly, by API key or by the deployment's subscription, on the claude-code harness. Every model in a catalog is a real model named by its id at the provider; there is no placeholder kind (the person's own endpoint is not a catalog entry).

Harness.description: The agent harness that drives a model.

Access.description: Who may pick a model: everyone on the deployment, or instance admins only.

ReasoningEffort.description: A reasoning-effort level, the one vocabulary every adapter maps onto its provider's own control: none — no reasoning · minimal · low · medium · high · xhigh · max. An adapter offers only the levels it can express (the claude CLI's --effort takes low…max; OpenRouter's reasoning.effort and the OpenAI reasoning_effort field take none…xhigh; a Qwen chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking toggle takes none and high).

Capabilities.description: What the model can do on this route. streaming and context_tokens reach the openai-agent harness; a model without tool calling cannot drive an agent turn and is refused at boot. reasoning_efforts lists the effort levels a person may pick for it (absent: the model has no effort control), default_effort the one a chat runs on until it picks.

ExtraBody.description: Server-specific request fields merged into every openai-agent request (e.g. a self-hosted Qwen's chat_template_kwargs). Never a credential.

Provider.description: One provider declaration. Which fields apply depends on the adapter; agent-api refuses a declaration whose fields its adapter does not take.

base_url.description: openai_compatible only: the endpoint's OpenAI-compatible root (http or https, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000/v1).

auth.description: none: a keyless endpoint. secret: the value secret_ref names. subscription (anthropic only): the deployment's own Claude subscription.

secret_ref.description: A REFERENCE to the credential, never the value: env:VEXA_MODEL_SECRET_<NAME> names a variable in agent-api's environment, delivered from the deployment's secret store. Only that prefix: a catalog can never name one of agent-api's own secrets.

model.description: The model's id at the provider (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-32B, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5).

max_output_tokens.description: The output-token cap this model's requests ask for (claude-code: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS; openai-agent: max_tokens). Absent: the deployment's VEXA_AGENT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, else the harness's own default.

effort_control.description: openai_compatible only: the request field a picked effort is sent as — reasoning_effort (the default; the OpenAI field) or enable_thinking (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking, a Qwen behind vLLM: none turns thinking off, high turns it on).

allowed_subjects.description: Open to these people only: each item is an exact sign-in address (compared case-insensitively) or a subject id. Everyone else neither sees the model nor can run it by naming it (not_permitted). For a model on a credential that belongs to one person, such as a personal subscription. Applies on top of access. Absent: the entry is open as access says.

default.description: The model a person runs on before they pick one. At most one entry.

Catalog.description: The operator's declaration (VEXA_MODEL_CATALOG). Unset or empty: no catalog, and every turn runs on the deployment's model and each person's Settings → Models exactly as without one.

ModelListEntry.description: One model as a person sees it: no endpoint, no credential, no request setting.

default.description: true on the catalog's own default entry

ModelList.description: GET /api/models: the models the caller may pick. default is the model the caller runs on before picking (the model they last picked in any chat, else their own Settings default, else the catalog's, else the first listed — each only while it is open to them; null when the list is empty). default_effort is the effort a new chat starts at: the one last picked with that model while the model still offers it (null: the model's default_effort). selected is the named chat's own pick, present when the request named a chat (null: the chat follows the default). selected_effort is the named chat's own effort pick, present with selected (null: the model's default_effort, or none when it has no effort control).

running.description: Asked for a chat: the model its worker was started on (the model the last turn ran on); null before any turn.
